domains.name: Client Assessment
domains.description: Client assessment: intake interviewing, identifying mental/social/environmental needs, and recognizing risk.

domains.name: Care Planning
domains.description: Care planning: creating needs-based plans and setting client-centered goals linked to services.

domains.name: Care Coordination
domains.description: Care coordination: connecting clients to services and navigating community systems.

domains.name: Communication Skills
domains.description: Communication skills: professional communication and empathy within professional boundaries.

domains.name: Documentation Skills
domains.description: Documentation skills: clear, accurate case notes and documenting services/progress.

domains.name: Behavioral Health Knowledge
domains.description: Behavioral health knowledge: recognizing mental health conditions and substance use disorders, and trauma-informed care.

domains.name: Ethics & Professionalism
domains.description: Ethics and professionalism: confidentiality/HIPAA and ethical decision-making.

domains.name: Work Readiness
domains.description: Work readiness: performing core case-management duties appropriately in a real-world setting.

competencies.statement: The learner can conduct a client intake interview effectively.
competencies.description: Runs an intake that gathers needed information respectfully.

competencies.statement: The learner can identify a client's mental, social, and environmental needs.
competencies.description: Distinguishes need types from intake information.

competencies.statement: The learner can recognize risk factors that require attention or escalation.
competencies.description: Flags safety/risk indicators and escalates appropriately.

competencies.statement: The learner can create a care plan that addresses a client's identified needs.
competencies.description: Builds a plan mapping needs to actions.

competencies.statement: The learner can set client-centered goals and connect them to appropriate services.
competencies.description: Writes SMART, client-centered goals with service links.

competencies.statement: The learner can connect clients to appropriate services and make effective referrals.
competencies.description: Selects and makes a fitting referral.

competencies.statement: The learner can navigate community systems and resources on a client's behalf.
competencies.description: Identifies the right system/resource for a need.

competencies.statement: The learner can communicate professionally with clients and team members.
The learner can demonstrate empathy while maintaining professional boundaries.
The learner can write clear, accurate, objective case notes.
The learner can document services provided and client progress.
The learner can recognize common mental health conditions relevant to case management.
The learner can recognize signs of substance use disorders and respond appropriately.
competencies.description: Notices indicators and takes an appropriate next step.

competencies.statement: The learner can apply trauma-informed care principles in client interactions.
competencies.description: Applies safety/trust/choice principles in a scenario.

competencies.statement: The learner can follow client confidentiality rules, including HIPAA where applicable.
competencies.description: Handles client information within confidentiality rules.

competencies.statement: The learner can apply ethical decision-making to case-management dilemmas.
competencies.description: Reasons through an ethical dilemma appropriately.

competencies.statement: The learner can perform core case-management duties appropriately in a real-world setting.
competencies.description: Integrates skills to handle a realistic end-to-end situation.
